**Summary**

I investigated ticket T-2007 and identified that the inventory-db-0 StatefulSet pod is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff with 23 restarts following an unclean node reboot. This is a known Kubernetes issue where StatefulSets can encounter volume attachment and pod recovery problems after non-graceful shutdowns. I provided the ticket owner with two recovery options: force delete the pod to trigger fresh creation, or mark the node as out-of-service to enable immediate recovery on a different node. Both approaches are documented in the Kubernetes documentation and will restore the database and dependent inventory-api services.
